selk.translation: abbr. Selkirk 塞尔扣克（英国郡名）; Selkirkshire 塞尔扣克郡

selkirk.definition: n. Scottish sailor who was put ashore on a deserted island off the coast of Chile for five years (providing the basis for Daniel Defoe's novel about Robinson Crusoe) (1676-1721)
selkirk.translation: n. 塞尔扣克（山名, 城市名）

selkirk mountains.translation: [网络] 赛尔科克地区；塞尔扣克山；塞尔扣克山脉

selkirkshire.translation: 塞尔扣克郡[英国苏格兰原郡名]

selkup.definition:
n. one of the people of mixed Ostyak and Samoyed origin in Siberia
n. the Uralic language spoken by the Ostyak-Samoyed
selkup.translation: n. 塞尔库普语(属乌拉尔语系); 塞尔库普人(属于西伯利亚北部的萨莫耶德人)

selkups.translation: (selkup 的复数) n. 塞尔库普语(属乌拉尔语系); 塞尔库普人(属于西伯利亚北部的萨莫耶德人)
